Date: 2025-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Evidence for renewal committee — concise ask

Hi Jasmine,

Our renewal meeting with the procurement and finance committee is scheduled for Nov 24. Procurement has asked for a single-page (plus appendix) evidence brief that explains the business outcomes Redwood has delivered for SkyBank over the past 12 months. Specifically they want:
- Quantified cost savings or cost avoidance tied to inference optimizations
- Latency improvements and how they impacted customer-facing SLAs
- Any clearance on data handling (SOC 2 / data residency statement) we can include in the packet

Can you provide a condensed pack (1 page executive summary + 1–2 appendix tables) by EOD Nov 20? If you need more time, please let me know.

Thanks,
Elena

SkyBank

Hi Elena / Marco,

Attached is the deliverable for the renewal packet: a one-page executive brief plus appendix tables. Executive summary bullets (top of page):
- Cost: Estimated run-rate token/hosting cost down ~38% (savings of $172k/year vs. baseline) after batching and quant changes. See cost_model_v2.xlsx for line items.
- Latency: p95 latency on the customer chat flow reduced from ~420ms to ~120ms after runtime kernel and batching changes, improving SLA headroom and reducing time-to-first-word for end-users by ~0.3s on average.
- Operational: Throughput increased ~3x at peak, meaning no additional reserved GPU commit required for expected holiday traffic.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II cover letter attached; data residency confirmed in the EU region, customer-managed KMS available on Dedicated deployments.

Attached files: SkyBank_Redwood_Impact_Brief.pdf, cost_model_v2.xlsx

Let us know if procurement needs a redacted sample invoice or a one-line procurement summary (we can do both). If this looks good, please confirm and we'll hand off to your procurement lead for inclusion in the committee packet.

Regards,
